_comment: Filling the box. Shapeless on purpose (Jonah, 2026-09-05): how you arrange tools in a toolbox is not
a thing the world should have an opinion about, only whether you have them. What is shaped is
The six are a real field kit, each mapped to something that already exists rather than to an invented
intermediate: a brush to dust a specimen, a crystal for the hand lens, a lodestone for the magnetic
test, a diamond as the hardness reference (Mohs 10), a barrel for the samples, and deretheni because
The crystal is a rime crystal, which a cold Age with a blizzard in it grows on its cliffs -- so the
instrument that tells you what an Age holds is itself built from something only a written Age can
give you. It stood in as an amethyst until 2026-09-05.
